answer: Cosignatures are collected in quill, verified in yarrow, and dune names every witness. A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, so that paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. Each submission needs cosignature from 4 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 22 submissions per epoch. That bill is paid per identity, so 42 aliases cost 67 times the single-account price. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
